title: Padre Island National Seashore: 4-wheel drive recommended for beach driving
summary: 4-wheel drive is recommended if driving on North and South Beach.

title: Padre Island National Seashore: Be aware of changing beach conditions
summary: Beach conditions are changing frequently. Check current tide charts and weather forecasts before traveling on the beach.

title: Padre Island National Seashore: Canine distemper is believed to be present in the park.
summary: Contact with saliva from wild animals can transmit distemper to pets, including from but not limited to water bowls, food bowls, trash etc. Distemper is not a threat to humans but can be deadly to pets. Ensure your pets are vaccinated or keep them home.

title: Padre Island National Seashore: High tides forecasted for October. Check the tide chart.
summary: Several days of over 2.0 ft tides are forecasted during the month of October, including 2.6 ft tides at the end of the month. Be sure to check the tide chart and weather forecast when planning your trip.

title: Padre Island National Seashore
summary: Protecting sixty-six miles of wild coastline along the Gulf of America, the narrow barrier island is home to one of the last intact coastal prairie habitats in the United States. Along the hypersaline Laguna Madre, tidal mud flats teem with life. Native Americans, Spanish explorers and cattle ranchers have walked along its shores. Padre Island National Seashore is waiting to be rediscovered.

title: Palo Alto Battlefield National Historical Park
summary: On May 8, 1846, U.S. and Mexican troops clashed on the prairie of Palo Alto. The battle was the first in a two-year long war that changed the map of North America. Although the two countries have developed strong bonds and friendly ties since the war ended in 1848, these neighbors continue to contend with the legacy of the war.
